articles.title: Tonga’s 2022 ‘Ultra’ Eruption Rewrote the Rules for Tsunamis. Now We Know Why
articles.summary: In 2022, the Hunga-Tonga Hunga-Haapai submarine volcano off Tonga's coast erupted, unleashing a devastating tsunami. This natural disaster completely destroyed every house on Mango Island, with only two buildings surviving. The event underscored the immense destructive power of underwater seismic activity and tsunamis in the Pacific region, impacting the island nation significantly.

articles.title: Lanterns Producer James Gunn Breaks Silence On Backlash Over Hal Jordan Story
articles.summary: Filmmaker James Gunn emphasizes that comic book fans recognize how both page-to-screen adaptations and the comics themselves frequently reinterpret original source material. This highlights the dynamic nature of storytelling, where creative liberties are taken to update narratives for new audiences and evolving contexts across different media. Aspirants should observe this trend in popular culture regarding creative adaptation and narrative interpretation.

articles.title: Will Aaron Pierre’s John Stewart Become a Staple of the DC Universe?
articles.summary: The article briefly discusses James Gunn's DC Universe, highlighting its promising but challenging early stages. It emphasizes the strategic importance of leveraging successful elements within this nascent franchise. 'Creature Commandos' is noted as an early project, suggesting the discussion delves into the DCU's creative direction, audience reception, and future development strategy.
